label: The explicit three-world chain is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive
paraphrase: The explicit three-world chain is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive. No world has full-predicate or full-modal-language MC. At middle p has both positive and negative accessible witnesses. The one-atom inventory has MC at left and hence possible MC at middle, while actual MC at middle fails; its box-closure assumption fails. Finite evaluator values and witness lists reproduce these distinctions.
